0x1000.text: Device type: the device profile number in the low 16 bits, profile-specific information in the high 16 bits
0x1000.details: 401 = generic I/O module, 402 = drive or motion controller. The configurator picks the built-in profile notes from this value.

0x1001.text: Error register: a summary of the device's current errors, one bit per kind

0x1002.text: Manufacturer status register: status bits defined by the manufacturer

0x1003.text: Error history: the latest emergency error codes, newest in sub 1

0x1003:0.text: Number of errors in the history; writing 0 clears the history

0x1003:1.text: An error: the EMCY error code in bits 0-15, manufacturer information in bits 16-31; sub 1 is the newest

0x1005.text: COB-ID of the SYNC message; bit 30 set means this device sends SYNC

0x1006.text: Communication cycle period: the SYNC interval; 0 means no SYNC is sent

0x1007.text: Synchronous window length: time after SYNC in which synchronous PDOs are sent; 0 means not used

0x100C.text: Guard time for node guarding; 0 means node guarding is off

0x100D.text: Life time factor: node guarding fails after guard time x this factor without a guard request

0x1010.text: Store parameters: writing "save" (0x65766173) stores the parameters in the device's non-volatile memory
0x1010.details: Reading a sub-index tells whether the device stores on command (bit 0) or by itself (bit 1). canworks never stores automatically.

0x1011.text: Restore default parameters: writing "load" (0x64616F6C) restores defaults, active after the next reset

0x1012.text: COB-ID of the TIME message; bit 31 set: the device receives TIME, bit 30 set: it sends TIME

0x1014.text: COB-ID of the emergency (EMCY) message; bit 31 set means the device sends no EMCY

0x1015.text: Inhibit time between two EMCY messages

0x1016.text: Consumer heartbeat times: the nodes this device monitors

0x1016:1.text: A monitored node: node ID in bits 16-23, heartbeat time in ms in bits 0-15; 0 means not used

0x1017.text: Producer heartbeat time: how often the device sends its heartbeat; 0 means no heartbeat

0x1018:2.text: Product code, set by the vendor

0x1018:3.text: Revision number: major revision in the high 16 bits, minor in the low 16 bits

0x1019.text: Synchronous counter overflow value: 0 means SYNC carries no counter, 2-240 the counter's highest value

0x1020.text: Verify configuration: the date and time of the configuration the device holds

0x1021.text: Store EDS: the device's own EDS, if it holds one

0x1022.text: Storage format of the stored EDS

0x1028.text: Emergency consumer: COB-IDs of EMCY messages this device receives

0x1029.text: Error behaviour: the NMT state the device switches to on a serious error

0x1029:1.text: Reaction to a communication error (such as bus-off or a heartbeat loss)

0x1200.text: SDO server parameter: the COB-IDs of an SDO channel the device serves

0x1200:1.text: COB-ID client to server (requests to the device)

0x1200:2.text: COB-ID server to client (answers from the device)

0x1200:3.text: Node ID of the SDO client

0x1280.text: SDO client parameter: an SDO channel this device uses to reach another node

0x1280:3.text: Node ID of the SDO server

0x1400.text: Receive PDO communication parameters: how this device receives one PDO

0x1400:1.text: COB-ID of the receive PDO; bit 31 set means the PDO is off

0x1400:2.text: Transmission type: 0-240 the received data is applied at the next SYNC, 254 and 255 at once

0x1400:5.text: Event timer: deadline for receiving the PDO; 0 means not monitored

0x1600.text: Receive PDO mapping: the objects the PDO's data is written to

0x1600:0.text: Number of mapped objects; set it to 0 before changing the mapping

0x1600:1.text: Mapped object: index in bits 16-31, sub-index in bits 8-15, length in bits in bits 0-7

0x1800.text: Transmit PDO communication parameters: when and how this device sends one PDO

0x1800:1.text: COB-ID of the transmit PDO; bit 31 set means the PDO is off

0x1800:2.text: Transmission type: 1-240 sent every N SYNCs, 0 at a SYNC after a change, 254 and 255 on change or timer

values.0: synchronous, acyclic (at a SYNC after a change)

0x1800:3.text: Inhibit time: the shortest time between two sends of the PDO

0x1800:5.text: Event timer: the PDO is sent at least this often (event-driven types); 0 means off

0x1800:6.text: SYNC start value: the SYNC counter value at which synchronous sending starts; 0 means not used

0x1A00.text: Transmit PDO mapping: the objects the PDO carries

0x1A00:0.text: Number of mapped objects; set it to 0 before changing the mapping

0x1A00:1.text: Mapped object: index in bits 16-31, sub-index in bits 8-15, length in bits in bits 0-7

0x1F50.text: Program data: the program or firmware download area

0x1F51.text: Program control: starts, stops or clears the program

0x1F56.text: Application software identification of the stored program

0x1F57.text: Flash status identification of the stored program

0x1F80.text: NMT start-up: how the device acts as NMT master or slave after power-on

bits.1: start all nodes with one command
bits.2: do not switch itself to operational
bits.4: reset all nodes when a mandatory node fails
bits.6: stop all nodes when a mandatory node fails

0x1F81.text: NMT slave assignment: per node ID, how the master treats that node

0x1F81:1.text: Slave assignment of a node: bits 0-7 flags, bits 8-15 retry factor, bits 16-31 guard time in ms

bits.0: node is a slave of this master

0x1F82.text: Request NMT: the NMT state of each node as the master sees it

0x1F84.text: Device type identification: the 0x1000 value the master expects from each node

0x1F85.text: Vendor identification: the vendor ID the master expects from each node

0x1F86.text: Product code: the product code the master expects from each node

0x1F87.text: Revision number: the revision the master expects from each node

0x1F88.text: Serial number: the serial number the master expects from each node

0x1F89.text: Boot time: time allowed for all mandatory nodes to boot; 0 means no limit
